flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmseserviceui pages/Payment/{PaymentSearchResult,PaymentProcess,PaymentResult}.ts and API.ts (no email input). ocmseserviceapi workflows/urapg/model/GenerateTransactionRequest + workflows/urapg/service/UraPaymentService (optional email field forwarded to the gateway), workflows/receipt/{controller/ReceiptController,service/ReceiptServiceImplement} (receipt PDF/ZIP for download, not emailed). ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, thirdpartyapi: no receipt sending to the offender
note: Status 'User Story Removed': the verdict stays Removed even though similar code exists. What exists: the ocmseserviceapi API accepts an optional email field and forwards it to the payment gateway (GenerateTransactionRequest.java:38-42, UraPaymentService.java:149 and 214), and the receipt PDF can be downloaded as a file (ReceiptController /v1/printslip). What does not exist: an email field on the payment page (the word email does not appear in pages/Payment/*.ts), the UI never sends an email (API.ts:179-198), and no code in the six repos emails the receipt PDF after payment. Whether the URA PG gateway sends a confirmation email using that field: cannot verify from repo. No related maintenance ticket.

steps.step: The payment page provides a field to enter an email address (optional)
steps.detail: The fine selection and payment mode page (PaymentSearchResult.ts) and the process page (PaymentProcess.ts) have no email input; the word email does not appear in pages/Payment/*.ts or in the FPayment type. Searched with email, mail and e-mail in the UI layer.

steps.step: The email entered (optional) is sent together with the transaction request
steps.detail: Server side: GenerateTransactionRequest has an optional email field without format validation (lines 38-42); UraPaymentService reads it, uses an empty string when null (line 149) and puts it in the gateway payload (line 214). UI side: APIPostGenerateTransaction sends only notices and paymentMethod (API.ts:186-190), so the portal never fills the email. Status Removed: code exists, so Sebagian.

steps.step: The system produces a PDF receipt for the payment
steps.detail: POST /v1/printslip builds a receipt PDF per notice (generatePdfFromHtml, ReceiptServiceImplement.java:124-127) and packs it into a ZIP when there is more than one; the UI downloads it through the Print Slip button (PaymentResult.ts:122-145). The receipt is only downloaded by the offender, not sent. Status Removed: code exists, so Sebagian.

steps.step: The PDF receipt is emailed to the offender after a successful payment
steps.detail: The successful payment callback (processCallback) only updates the transaction and the notice status (EPaymentCallbackService.java:64-160); there is no email/SMTP call or PDF attachment. Searched with mail, email, sendReceipt and attachment in the six repos; the only email sender in ocmseserviceapi is FurnishEmailService (furnish hirer/driver). A confirmation email the gateway may send: cannot verify from repo.
